agent_reported.note: Re-verified all key evidence after compaction: TX-9002 (auth, not_captured, released 2026-09-18) and TX-9001 (settlement, captured) both tie to INV-2609 but represent one logical charge - auth timeout + retry per POL-B-AUTH v1. No duplicate $149 charge occurred. S-22's refund promise in SUP-5601 violates POL-B-REF (agents cannot promise refunds pre-review). Deep Time add-on ($30, TX-9003/INV-2609-AO) is legitimate per POL-B-ADD (added by admin U-2 on 2026-09-12, applied at next renewal 2026-09-14, full price - correct). July upgrade proration INV-2607P $59.60 matches POL-B-PRO formula (149 * 12/30 = 59.6) - correct, matches SUP-5549 conclusion. However CR-778 ($19.60 unused-time credit from that same upgrade, issued 2026-07-02) remains unapplied with owner_notified=false - now >30 days old (it's Sept), auto_apply disabled since SUP-5390 (2026-05-02) - this violates POL-B-CRD which requires flagging unapplied credits >30 days old to owner. This is the one confirmed ACTUAL_ERROR. Ready to draft final report.

summary_text: Investigation into C-1042's billing dispute (SUP-5601/5602) is essentially complete after re-verification post-compaction. Gathered/confirmed all account, subscription, invoice, payment, credit, ticket, and policy data. Conclusions: (1) The apparent "duplicate" $149 charge on 9/14 was actually one authorization (TX-9002) that timed out and was retried/captured as TX-9001; auth released 2026-09-18, no funds double-charged - S-22's refund promise in SUP-5601 improperly violated POL-B-REF (no pre-review refund promises). (2) The $30 Deep Time Analytics add-on (TX-9003/INV-2609-AO) is legitimate per POL-B-ADD - added by admin U-2, charged full price at next renewal. (3) July upgrade proration INV-2607P ($59.60) correctly matches POL-B-PRO formula. (4) The one confirmed actual error: credit CR-778 ($19.60, issued 2026-07-02, unapplied, owner_notified=false) is now >30 days old with auto-apply disabled, violating POL-B-CRD's flagging requirement. Ready to draft final report to close SUP-5602's open obligations.}
